defects.traversal check before normalize: resolveUpload checks startsWith(root) on the un-normalized path, then returns path.normalize(requested), so a name like ../../../etc/passwd passes the check and is written outside UPLOAD_ROOT.
defects.label ReDoS: LABEL_PATTERN in validators.js has a nested quantifier with an optional separator, so a 63-letter run followed by '!' has exponentially many ways to split and rejecting it takes effectively forever.
defects.sort injection: orderColumn in validators.js returns the raw sort value when it is not a key of SORT_COLUMNS, and listUploadsSql interpolates it into ORDER BY, so sort=created_at; DROP TABLE uploads runs as SQL.
defects.SVG served inline: mime.js lists image/svg+xml as inline-safe, so an uploaded SVG is served with inline disposition and its script runs in the app origin.

decoys.decoy filename star: encodeURIComponent in the filename* parameter lets a crafted upload name break out of the Content-Disposition value or inject headers.
decoys.decoy sortDirection: sortDirection returns the raw dir string when it is not asc, so a dir value containing SQL reaches the ORDER BY text.
decoys.decoy label check order: The label check now runs before the try block, so a rejected label still reaches createUpload and is stored.
